releaseNotes:
Medical Store Point of Sale v1.4.1
- Settings: Implemented in-session Reset Password with dual SQLite & Central SaaS Cloud synchronization
- Settings: Removed obsolete Performance Testing tab and developer passkey prompt
- Auth Hardening: Resolved duplicate OTP delivery with rate-limiter and request deduplication
- Auth Hardening: Resolved password reset rejection during login by synchronizing BCrypt hash to cloud PostgREST
- Deployment: Self-contained packaging bundling .NET 8 runtime directly with application
